notes.title: Welcome to The Third’s Steam Page
notes.notes: Hello everyone. Welcome to The Third’s Steam page. The game is currently under development and has made great progress so far. I’ll continue to share updates here, including gameplay mechanics and in-game visuals. I kindly ask for your engagement on this page. Hearing your feedback and requests always makes me happy and helps make the game even better. Every wishlist on Steam is incredibly valuable. If the game fits your taste and you like what you see, please don’t forget to add it to your wishlist and follow the page. And of course, feel free to share it with your friends :) Thank you in advance for everything!
